visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with long black pigtails tied with white ribbons, wearing a red and white cheerleader-style top with '08' printed on the front, stands next to a male character with long black dreadlocks wearing a bright blue baseball-style jersey over a dark t-shirt. They are positioned behind a dark wooden table against a plain, brightly lit white wall. The female character is actively gesturing with both hands open while looking and smiling at the camera, while the male character maintains a calm, neutral facial expression and looks directly forward. (2) The scene transitions to a top-down view of several packaged food products arranged on a dark wooden surface. Visible items include a pink and white box labeled with Korean text and a cartoon character, a small white plastic yogurt-like container with a blue lid, a red rectangular box featuring cartoon children, and a green can with a floral design. The lighting is bright and flat, emphasizing the packaging details of each object without any shadows. (3) The camera returns to the two characters who are now each holding a small white plastic cup and a silver spoon. They are seen dipping their spoons into a thick, creamy white substance inside the cups and bringing it to their mouths. Both characters smile and nod their heads in approval after tasting the food. The background remains the static white wall, and their movements are coordinated as they interact with each other and the food. (4) They are now seen holding large, ornate glass goblets filled with a dark, opaque liquid. They raise their glasses toward each other, clinking them together in a 'cheers' gesture before taking a sip. The female character's eyes are wide and expressive, showing a pleasant reaction to the drink. The male character continues to look at her while holding his glass. (5) Both characters are eating from small, square white bowls containing a soft, white gelatinous dessert. The female character uses a spoon to scoop the dessert, initially showing a focused and slightly squinted facial expression before breaking into a wide smile. The male character is seen consuming the dessert with a silver spoon, nodding his head slightly while looking at the bowl. (6) The characters hold glass goblets containing a translucent amber liquid. As they drink, pink heart-shaped graphics and sparkle animations appear over the frame around the female character's face. She makes a heart shape with her hands and smiles broadly, her eyes squinting in delight. The male character watches her with a slight smile while holding his glass steady on the table. (7) Returning to the initial setup, the male character is now holding and showing two different product boxes to the camera—one white and one gold and red. The female character stands beside him, looking at the products and pointing toward them while speaking. The video concludes with a full-screen graphic featuring several lines of text in Traditional Chinese, each accompanied by a red checkmark on a white background.

The female speaker's voice maintains a narrative tone with frequent pitch modulations to keep the listener's attention. The female speaker continues to describe the flavor profile with clear articulation and positive valence. There is a slight rustling sound of clothing as the characters move their arms to eat. (7) A loud, percussive 'thud' occurs as a product box is placed on the wooden table, followed by the sound of cardboard being handled.
